logo:
Use case: logo-brand. Create an original production game logo for the exact title "RAIL ARENA", an original fast railgun arena shooter for Windows. Deliver ONE polished horizontal logo lockup on a genuinely TRANSPARENT background, no mockup, no backdrop, no checkerboard printed into art, no characters, no extra text or tagline.
Brand language: precise, kinetic, competitive sci-fi with high-quality stylized low-poly/beveled armor aesthetics. Strong compact symbol on the left built from two parallel cyan rail strokes and a geometric cut-angle A/arena gateway silhouette; simple memorable original silhouette, readable as an emblem at small sizes. To its right, a very bold legible custom geometric uppercase wordmark reading exactly RAIL ARENA on one line. Confident spacing, open counters, clean carefully finished vector-like edges, restrained shallow bevel planes, no ultra-thin details.
Palette grounded in the game's approved ivory armor and teal/cyan insets: warm ivory letter faces, graphite outer strokes/cutouts for contrast on BOTH white and dark GitHub backgrounds, saturated electric cyan rail accent, a small muted teal secondary plane. Graphic and refined, mostly flat colors with very subtle modeled edge planes. No chrome noise, gradients across every letter, hazy glow, decorative chains, generic military shields, stars, skulls, crosshair, gun silhouette or franchise imitation.
Wide landscape composition about 3:1 logo proportions, emblem and wordmark visually balanced, tightly framed with modest clear transparent padding around all sides. All letters and emblem fully inside the canvas. Pixel-sharp legible typography that remains readable when scaled to a README header. Preserve actual alpha transparency. Only text: RAIL ARENA.
banner:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: official-looking project README BRAND BANNER for the original game Rail Arena. Create ONE very wide panoramic image, exactly a THREE-TO-ONE aspect ratio (for example 2400 by 800), composed as a clean readable horizontal GitHub README hero, not a vertical poster.
INPUT ROLES: Image 1 is the NEW RAIL ARENA LOGO artwork to preserve: same angular A/parallel-cyan-rails emblem, ivory beveled letter faces, graphite outlines, and exact wordmark spelling RAIL ARENA. Image 2 is the approved four-character concept; preserve these four specific identities, hairstyles, gender, skin colors, armor silhouettes and palettes.
Composition: left 45 percent is calm dark graphite negative space containing the supplied logo LARGE, front-facing, fully legible, flat in the graphic plane, with generous clear margins and no crop or distortion. Use the exact supplied symbol and wordmark, not a new font or another logo. Right 55 percent shows the FOUR contenders together in a tasteful high-quality stylized low-poly game-art scene, fully recognizable, adult athletic proportions, sculpted faces and hair, layered beveled armor, clean hands. Ivory/teal/cyan dark-haired male player nearest the center; terracotta/amber woman with tied bun; pale-haired slate/ivory male; deep-brown-skinned plum/copper woman with locs over her right temple and cropped left temple. Maintain the character design in the approved image. Arrange them in a coherent confident neutral hero group, slightly staggered in depth, full figures visible on a platform, no cloned people or fifth character. Hands relaxed at sides; do not invent weapon designs.
Environment is an understated original sci-fi foundry arena with layered metal platforms, a distant elevated bridge, angular ramps and restrained cyan guide lights. Background stays quiet and atmospheric so the logo and characters dominate. Strong graphic silhouette, polished faceted surfaces and soft cinematic rim light, graphite/navy shadows, warm ivory highlights, electric cyan accents, restrained terracotta and copper only from the approved cast/environment. Two fine parallel cyan rail-energy streaks can connect the background composition without crossing faces or obscuring letters.
No UI, gameplay HUD, badges, awards, numbers, slogans, extra copy, watermark or franchise imagery. This is concept BRAND ART, not a fake gameplay screenshot. Only text is the preserved logo RAIL ARENA. Do not add the reference sheet's labels or headings. Keep safe margins and ensure the entire logo and all four characters fit comfortably in the 3:1 wide banner.
